source_context: research/experimental_execution/review_pending.py: original history and strict annual crossing
research/experimental_execution/risk_priced_fan_rollout.py: old finite empirical-risk-price family, kept immutable
objective: A separately versioned state-dependent filter that constrains declared next-year real-wealth outcomes before considering growth. It removes a local empirical breach-price eta from the safety inequality; it does not remove support/forecast assumptions or guarantee improved coverage.

inputs.C: cumulative CPI before the current return period, positive
inputs.P: original-history maximum real wealth, including initial preallocation wealth
inputs.t_H: calendar year index and immutable original horizon

derived.z: V/(C*P), in (0,1] for a consistent nonwithdrawal account

original_account_state.no_reset: Preserve original CPI, historical P, original MDD, original H and absorbing ever-breached flag. A new trade cannot erase an already recorded crossing.
original_account_state.past_breach: If M-L>the declared numerical convention, return already_breached/pending, not a new safe certificate. Holding during pending is an administrative continuation and is not guaranteed safe.

joint_support.input_schema: At calendar t, each frozen training row s supplies the JOINT vector (g_equity,g_bond,g_bill,h), where g=1+nominal_return>0 and h=1+inflation>0.
joint_support.real_gross: a_s,i = g_s,i/h_s. Do not combine separate marginal worst asset returns and maximum inflation into an undeclared joint row.
joint_support.within_year_convex_hull: The displayed inequalities are affine in the joint (g,h) vector, so checking all declared rows also covers their convex hull. This is an explicitly declared support assumption, not a probability estimate or evidence that future observations lie inside it.
joint_support.cross_year_scope: Independent per-calendar support sets imply a rectangular product of within-year joint supports for a full-path conditional guarantee. Keeping the same original training member across years is a different, smaller nonrectangular set; the two claims must not be interchanged.
joint_support.domain_limit: There is no unconditional future support-membership guarantee. Bill nominal gains can coexist with negative real returns. Calendar support is the planned primary source; pooled support, if used later, is a separately labelled stress, not selected after seeing evaluation outcomes.

exact_next_year_constraint.fee_and_post: For target w, Cfee=kappa*sum_i max((V-Cfee)*w_i-x_i,0), post y=(V-Cfee)*w. For hold, y=x and Cfee=0.
exact_next_year_constraint.full_current_budget_floor: Rnext_s >= (1-L)*P for every declared support row.
exact_next_year_constraint.proof: If M<=L, then when Rnext<=P the inequality gives currentDDnext<=L; when Rnext>P the new peak equals wealth and currentDDnext=0. Thus Mnext<=L. The proof is conditional on support membership, exact fees and a feasible chosen action.
exact_next_year_constraint.annual_not_intrayear: The condition controls annual endpoints. It does not certify an unobserved intrayear path or the instantaneous post-fee mark. If an extra immediate posttrade floor is desired, sum(y)/C>=F is another linear constraint that must be declared separately before evaluation.
exact_next_year_constraint.no_future_existence_claim: A one-step feasible action does not imply a feasible action will exist next year. An all-H promise needs recursive feasibility or a separately stated sufficient certificate.

budget_release_ratio.definition: For unbreached R>=F, F_rho=R-rho*(R-F)=F+(1-rho)*(R-F), with rho in (0,1].
budget_release_ratio.interpretation: rho releases the stated fraction of the current drawdown headroom for next-year losses; rho=1 uses the full client floor, smaller rho retains a buffer. This is not a risk-probability threshold, utility risk-aversion estimate or empirically identified preference.
budget_release_ratio.candidate_family_from_root: Prospective six engine candidates: rho in {0.5,0.75,1.0} crossed with forecast in {uniform,ensemble_min}; no choice or result has been assessed in this theoretical task.
budget_release_ratio.constraint: For every joint row, (g_s dot y) - C*h_s*F_rho >= 0.
budget_release_ratio.nonpositive_headroom: Do not silently apply the release formula to a breached/inconsistent state or reset its peak. Endpoint tolerance and validation of tiny negative headroom are engineering conventions, not additional financial risk budgets.

one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.line: For lambda in [0,1], y_lambda=x+lambda*(y_star-x), C_lambda=lambda*C_star, moved_lambda=lambda*moved_star.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.proof: Every positive destination increment scales by lambda: sum max(y_lambda-x,0)=lambda*sum max(y_star-x,0). Also sum(y_lambda)=V-lambda*C_star. Hence the original fee equation and self-financing identity hold exactly; costs are paid once.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.implied_weights: w_lambda=y_lambda/(V-lambda*C_star); this generally differs from (1-lambda)*u+lambda*w_star. Interpolating prefee target weights and assigning a proportional fee is not the same operation.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.support_margin: A_s + lambda*B_s >=0, A_s=(a_s dot x)/C-F_rho, B_s=(a_s dot (y_star-x))/C.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.closed_interval: Intersect [0,1] with lambda>=-A/B when B>0 and lambda<=-A/B when B<0; B=0 with A<0 makes the segment infeasible. Preserve lower and upper binding support IDs, empty intervals and numeric margins. Numerical tolerance must not turn a genuinely infeasible interval into a safety certificate.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.action_menu_from_root: After inception, separate one-dimensional segments toward w, 0.75*w+0.25*e_bill, 0.5*w+0.5*e_bill, and 0.25*w+0.75*e_bill. These are strictly declared destinations, not data-selected allocations. Each segment has its own exact endpoint fee.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.initial_rule_from_root: At inception the original full target w must satisfy the declared support budget after its exact initial fee, or the account is preinvestment Review/financial NULL. No per-scenario-ID or future-path initial admission; identical known initial states imply identical decisions.
one_dimensional_exact_fee_geometry.continuation_rule_status: Root is freezing the new engine API and tie rules separately. This review does not instantiate a new service or modify the old frozen rule.

growth_versus_protection.growth_value: A direct one-year forecast objective can be mean_s log(Rnext_s/R), with the exact fee inside Rnext. This is not a recursive Q^pi or a full-H optimality claim. Uniform means and a predeclared minimum over ensemble member mean-log forecasts can be evaluated directly on each feasible segment.
growth_versus_protection.concavity: For fixed endpoint, each Rnext_s is positive affine in lambda; mean log is concave, and a minimum of such concave ensemble objectives is concave. A bounded one-dimensional optimizer can retain endpoint/derivative/tie witnesses.
growth_versus_protection.when_hold_is_feasible: If the growth objective includes lambda=0 and selects a strictly better feasible point, its predicted net mean-log advantage is nonnegative relative to hold by construction. It remains a forecast, not a realized-gain guarantee.
growth_versus_protection.when_hold_is_infeasible: A necessary protection trade may have negative forecast growth advantage relative to hold. Report it as risk-constraint enforcement after fees, not as positive expected financial benefit.
growth_versus_protection.protection_value: Use the explicit worst support deficit S(y)=max_s max(F_rho-Rnext_s(y),0), together with minimum support slack, endpoint fees and moved amounts. A feasible protection reduces positive S(hold) to zero within the declared support.
growth_versus_protection.least_change_option: A transparent low-dimensional variant chooses the least moved feasible point when hold fails, with predeclared deterministic fee/growth/destination ties; when hold is safe it allows a net-growth-improving feasible trade. Root may instead optimize growth over all safe points; the distinction must be frozen before training.
growth_versus_protection.no_double_counting: Fee differences between chosen actions and a reference are accounting differences. They are not uniquely identified causal risk-versus-growth contributions. Do not execute a protection trade and then an additional growth trade while charging a single combined-segment fee.

full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.exact_robust_viability: With normalized state (z,u), terminal K_H={(z,u):z>=1-L}; backward K_t consists of states with some exact self-financing action whose successor is in K_{t+1} for every declared joint support row. Successor r=(a dot y)/(C*P), z_next=min(r,1), u_next=(g*y)/(g dot y). Full-H induction requires this recursion, not simply K_t=one-step-safe states.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.complexity_boundary: A grid approximation of K must be labelled approximate. Ordinary interpolation of a feasible grid is not by itself an inner safety proof. No such DP or grid has been run in this task.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.bill_lower_gross: b_t=min_s g_s,bill/h_s. It may be below 1.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.bill_backward_threshold: k_H=1-L. If the next bill certificate is empty, the earlier one remains empty. Otherwise k_t=max(1-L,k_{t+1}/b_t); k_t>1 makes that suffix bill certificate empty. Do not divide a later impossible k>1 by a large earlier return and falsely revive it, because a new historical peak caps z at 1.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.exact_switch_to_bill: Switching arbitrary holdings x to all bills leaves A_bill=x_bill+(x_equity+x_bond)/(1+kappa). The switch fee is kappa*(x_equity+x_bond)/(1+kappa). Subsequent all-bill holding has no transfer fees.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.optional_sufficient_set: F_t contains states with a nonempty bill suffix certificate and A_bill/(C*P)>=k_t. This is a sufficient fallback set and may be much smaller than the true viability set.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.linear_next_fallback_test: For a current post vector y, define r_s=(a_s dot y)/(C*P) and ell_s=[a_bill*y_bill+(a_equity*y_equity+a_bond*y_bond)/(1+kappa)]/(C*P). Requiring ell_s>=k_{t+1} AND ell_s>=k_{t+1}*r_s ensures next state can switch to bills after its exact fee despite Pnext=P*max(1,r_s). Both are linear in y and hence lambda.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.last_year: At t=H-1 require only r_s>=1-L. There is no invented terminal liquidation or rebalancing fee.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.conditional_induction: If a controller requires the optional next-fallback test and starts from a nonempty feasible action set, support-realized successors lie in F_{t+1}; an all-bill fallback remains available, so repeated safe selection controls the entire annual-endpoint MDD within the declared rectangular support.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.root_scope_decision: The adopted research direction uses the one-step support filter as engine core. The all-H bill certificate is a separate conservative feasibility diagnostic, not a gate that cancels the new research when empty. Empty bill certificate does not prove the full three-asset strategy set is infeasible.
full_path_viability_and_optional_bill_di.coverage_tradeoff: More adaptive weights can enlarge feasible actions relative to old hold/full-restore choices. Robust supports, retained buffers and an all-H fallback certificate can also reduce coverage. Improvement of actual risk and coverage is an empirical whole-policy question, not a theorem of the filter.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: one_step_not_recursive
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: Two years, L=0.2, zero fee, every asset real gross=0.8 each year, initial R=P=100.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: Year1 ends at80 and passes the first one-step floor80. Year2 must end at64, below the unchanged peak floor80; no allocation can avoid it. The all-H bill certificate is empty from inception.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: peak_ratchet_matters
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: L=0.2, all assets real gross1.5 then0.7, zero fees, initial R=P=100.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: Endpoints150 then105 both exceed the obsolete initial floor80, but the new peak150 gives MDD30%. A floor permanently anchored to the original100 is not a drawdown filter.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: fees_reverse_boundary_feasibility
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: x=(100,0,0), CPI1, P100, L0.1, switching fully to bill, kappa0.0025, bill next real gross0.9.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: Ignoring the fee predicts90 and a pass; exact post-bill wealth100/1.0025 gives next real wealth90/1.0025<90, hence a failure. This example concerns that proposed trade; holding may have a different certificate.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: nominal_bill_is_not_real_floor
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: Bill nominal gross1.02, inflation gross1.05, initial R=P100, L0.02.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: Bill real gross34/35<0.98, so even a nominal bill gain does not meet this one-year real drawdown floor.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: preserve_joint_hedging
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: Joint real-gross rows (0.5,1.5,1) and (1.5,0.5,1), no fee; half equity and half bond.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: Portfolio real gross is1 on both declared rows. Combining separate marginal minima into(0.5,0.5,1) invents an undeclared co-crash and falsely removes that hedge.

hand_constructed_counterexamples.name: support_escape
hand_constructed_counterexamples.setup: All declared support rows preserve the proposed floor, but a later actual joint outcome has all real gross below1-L relative to a peak state.
hand_constructed_counterexamples.result: The conditional certificate says nothing about this outside-support outcome. A positive historical support minimum is not a future guarantee.

proposed_pure_API_and_witnesses.forecast_inputs: support_joint_gross(N,4) and declared support member IDs/hash, budget_release_ratio, frozen destination list, one-year forecast inputs/weights or ensemble grouping. Never pass actual current-year return, future actual suffix, evaluation scenario ID or final121-180 data into choice.
pure_outputs: selected destination ID, lambda, post-dollar holdings, exact fee and moved
every destination feasible interval and lower/upper binding support IDs
minimum support slack and all predicted support deficits
predicted one-year net log growth of hold/chosen and their difference
support/forecast hashes, originalH and state snapshots
certificate_scope explicitly one_step_support_only unless a separate all-H certificate is actually required/proven
proposed_pure_API_and_witnesses.failure_semantics: No feasible action is a recorded outcome. If an existing client cannot satisfy the filter, do not return a financial NULL row that deletes its prior loss, reset capital or silently substitute a guaranteed cash account. Service handling and physical continuation must be separately predeclared and all admitted paths retained.
proposed_pure_API_and_witnesses.fit_evaluation_boundary: A complete deterministic annual policy must be run through originalH under whole-scenario outer folds; local safety/forecast witnesses are not recursively optimized Q^pi. Support coverage, everbreach, severity, service interruption, initial coverage, fees and growth need distinct denominators.

mandatory_synthetic_checks_for_future_en: Exact post-dollar line preserves fee equation and funding at0, interior lambda and1; all costs paid once.
Closed-interval inequalities handle positive/negative/zero slopes, impossible rows and binding ties.
Target unsafe/hold safe, target safe/hold unsafe, both unsafe but an interior feasible point, and genuinely empty segment.
No scenarioID/futureactual dependency; identical initial states give identical full-target admission.
Peak ratchet, original CPI, original runningMDD and absorbing crossing survive state advancement.
Nominal positive but real negative bill outcome; support inflation remains joint with returns.
Historical breach cannot regain an unbreached safety status; no impossible bill certificate is revived backward.
Minimum support slack is recomputed from actual selected post vector, not inferred from rounded lambda alone.
next_step: Await root-frozen engine API; implement additive source/synthetic tests only, then a separately frozen development-only protocol and full-policy nested evaluation on IDs1-120. This document itself executes no strategy and authorizes no final reread or service change.
